request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When does my residence permit expire, and what should I do before then?

response.text:
Your student residence permit expires on Mon 30 Nov 2026 [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf]. To stay longer, you need to apply for the extension before that date.

**What to do:**
- **Go to your appointment.** The Ausländerbehörde has booked you for Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]. It is at Musterplatz 1, 2nd floor, Room 2.14.
- **Bring the originals the letter lists.** These are your valid passport, the enrolment certificate for winter semester 2026/27, and proof of funds. You also need proof of health insurance, a biometric photo (35 × 45 mm), and your tenancy contract or landlord confirmation.
- **Pay the fee by girocard.** The fee is 100.00 € [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m]. It is due on the day of the appointment, and cash is not accepted.
- **Cancel early if you can't attend.** The letter asks for at least three working days' notice. Ordnung has a to-do for this with a send-by date of Tue 13 Oct 2026 [item:itm_jr5r71kc1r78]. Check that date against the letter, because it was computed and not read from the letter.
- **Check your passport.** It expires on Wed 10 Feb 2027 [item:itm_cw9j6w5ppdvs]. A permit generally can't be issued for longer than the passport is valid. Ordnung flags this passport date as needing a check, so compare it with the passport itself. You may want to ask the office about it at the appointment.

**Why applying on time matters:** if you apply before the permit expires, it usually counts as still valid until the office decides (§ 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG). Ask for a Fiktionsbescheinigung [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf]. The letter itself is dated 16 Sep 2026 [doc:doc_d9hwr1mp3bsj].

For residence matters, get advice if anything is unclear.

Ihre Aufenthaltserlaubnis zum Zweck des Studiums nach § 16b Abs. 1 des Aufenthaltsgesetzes
